long_biography.plain_text:
Wilhelm von Finck Hauptverwaltung gives the family’s inherited land and investment holdings a dedicated management structure. The Munich-based office oversees property, company stakes and asset-management matters, while the inherited estate also included agriculture and forestry. Professional executives, rather than von Finck personally, handle its day-to-day management.

That structure follows an earlier asset-management firm Wilhelm von Finck Junior established with his father in 1988. Deutsche Bank later acquired that business, which ultimately became part of Deutsche Oppenheim Family Office. His separate family administration remains active, while a Manhattan office building co-owned with Paramount Group illustrates its international property strategy.
